C1103.title: Woman Sentenced for AI Face-Swapping Romance Scam Involving 130,000 Yuan
C1103.summary: A woman used AI face-swapping technology to conduct an online romance scam, defrauding a victim of 130,000 yuan. After considering her active restitution and obtaining the victim's forgiveness, the court sentenced her to three years in prison, suspended for four years. This case illustrates the use of AI face-swapping in romance fraud.
